description: Provenance declaration for Phase 2C metric fixtures (docs/phase-2c-test-plan.md Section 6). Most individually-enumerated edge cases from the handoff's required-case lists (Sections 23-27) remain executable pytest cases built inline via tests/metrics/conftest.py's short_interest_record/borrow_record helpers, rather than duplicated as static JSON/JSONL records -- this mirrors Phase 2B's own documented choice (tests/fixtures/metrics/phase_2b_fixture_metadata.json) and keeps every required case independently named and traceable in the test files themselves.

phase_2c_cli_demo_observations.jsonl.purpose: Offline build-market-metrics CLI demonstration input: one published short-interest pair, one borrow fee/availability pair, and three daily market bars for synthetic symbol TESTC.

phase_2c_metric_cases.json.purpose: CLI --spec cases list covering one metric from each of the five Phase 2C metric families against phase_2c_cli_demo_observations.jsonl.

expected_phase_2c_metric_metadata.json.purpose: Deterministic anchor hash manifest for the required Phase 2C result names (handoff Section 30).
